decisions.briefing: Markets drifted lower today with NASDAQ -0.3% and S&P 500 -0.4% on no major catalyst — a neutral, low-conviction session. Cash on hand ($489.29) sits just under our $500 buy threshold, so per our own playbook we're holding rather than forcing a purchase into 3 open slots on a non-risk-on day, and letting our 7 existing positions ride.

market_education.summary_en: Both major indices slipped modestly today, with no clear single driver — this kind of drift is typical of a quiet, indecisive trading session rather than a reaction to specific news. Volume and volatility both appear muted, consistent with investors waiting for the next data catalyst rather than repositioning aggressively. Without a strong signal in either direction, staying put and preserving capital is the more disciplined choice than chasing marginal setups.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日兩大指數均小幅下挫，並無明顯單一觸發因素，這種漂移走勢較符合淡靜、方向不明的交易日,而非對特定消息的反應。成交量與波動度均顯溫和，反映投資者在等待下一個數據指標，而非積極調倉。在缺乏明確方向訊號的情況下，按兵不動、保留資金會比勉強追逐邊際機會更為審慎。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" refers to cash kept in reserve rather than fully invested, so it's ready to deploy when a genuinely strong opportunity appears. On a neutral day like today, with available cash just under our buying threshold, holding that cash rather than forcing a trade preserves flexibility for a better setup later.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指刻意保留現金、不全數投入市場，以便在真正出現強勢機會時能迅速加碼。像今天這種方向不明的中性交易日，可用現金剛好低於我們的買入門檻，此時按兵不動、保留現金，比勉強交易更能為日後更好的機會保留彈性。
